operations.title: Entry 1218 — The Five-Site Occurrence Kernel Is Trivial Under Every Edge-Sheet Flip
operations.summary: All 240 complementary occurrence generators have identical labelled boundary-edge vectors on A and A^c. Hence every C2^5 edge-sheet flip acts trivially on the rank-240 kernel: K_occ=1 tensor Q[C5]^48. The first-Rees symbols and soft Koszul/conormal attachments are also edge-sheet invariant; the physical measure contributes only the separate external-Gram Kummer character.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the five-site occurrence deck-character audit
operations.body: Entry 1218 checks all 240 occurrence generators. Since ∂A=∂A^c as labelled edge vectors, every C2^5 sheet flip acts identically on q_A and q_Ac. Therefore K_occ=1_(C2^5)⊗Q[C5]^48. The first-Rees symbols 2rho X_A and the soft Koszul/conormal attachments remain deck invariant. Occurrence multiplicity and coefficient-sheet multiplicity are independent; only the separate det(H)^(-1/2) physical measure twist remains. Next is marked-relative cohomology by C2^5 character.
